description: A US Bankruptcy Court order discharging the debtor (and, where included, discharging the trustee and closing the case), with its explanation page

court.description: The court and district as printed in the heading, e.g. 'United States Bankruptcy Court - District of South Carolina'

form_number.description: The court form identifier printed at the top of the order, e.g. 'Form 166BNC'

case_number.description: The bankruptcy case number as printed beside 'Case Number'

chapter.description: The bankruptcy chapter the case was under, e.g. 7

docket_number.description: The docket (document) number of this order, e.g. from 'Document 9' or 'Doc 9'

debtor.description: The debtor named in the 'In re' block

name.description: The debtor's primary name, the first name line of the 'In re' block

other_names.description: Other names used by the debtor (aka, fka, dba), each without its prefix

address.description: The debtor's address as one line

ssn_last_four.description: The last four digits of the Social Security or Individual Taxpayer number

order_titles.description: Each order title in the order heading, e.g. 'DISCHARGE OF DEBTOR', 'ORDER CLOSING CASE'

entered_date.description: The date in the 'Entered By The Court' box, as YYYY-MM-DD

filed_date.description: The date in the 'Filed By The Court' box, as YYYY-MM-DD

clerk_of_court.description: The clerk of court's name printed in the 'Filed By The Court' box

discharge_statute.description: The statute under which the discharge is granted, as cited, e.g. 'section 727 of title 11, United States Code'

trustee_discharged.description: True if the order discharges the trustee

case_closed.description: True if the order closes the case

signed_place.description: The place printed above the signature, e.g. 'Columbia, South Carolina'

signed_date.description: The date printed above the signature, as YYYY-MM-DD

signer_title.description: The title printed under the signature, e.g. 'United States Bankruptcy Judge'

is_signed.description: True if the signature line carries a signature

ecf_entered_timestamp.description: The 'Entered' date and time in the electronic filing header line at the top of the page, as printed

debts_not_discharged.description: From the explanation page: each listed common type of debt that is not discharged

items.description: One type of debt, as printed, without its list letter
